rules.name: Gola
rules.logical_profile_conflict: With seven-body Ashraya and literal all-Nabhasa precedence, one occupied sign always triggers Rajju/Musala/Nala; Gola cannot become operative. Count is still reported.

rules.name: Kulavardhana
rules.logical_profile_conflict: Including Sun and Moon constrains allowable fifth-from-reference signs to a subset of a trine set. Opposite Rahu/Ketu cannot both belong to it. Seven-body interpretation is a different option.

rules.name: advanced_raaja_07
rules.logical_profile_conflict: The selected Parashari D2 maps Asc and every planet only to Cancer/Leo. No implemented full graha aspect reaches the same or adjacent sign, so six-chart aspect conjunction including D2 cannot be met.

rules.name: advanced_raaja_13
rules.logical_profile_conflict: Exchange places fourth/tenth lords opposite each other. No classical full graha-aspect set contains an opposite pair. The same 5th/9th lord cannot aspect both; the wording may instead permit different aspecting lords, which is not selected silently.

rules.name: advanced_raaja_17
rules.logical_profile_conflict: With opposite Rahu/Ketu included as malefics, both cannot occupy the set of houses {3,6,11}; no two members are opposite. Seven-body interpretation is a different option.

scope: Complete inventory and reproducible execution coverage; not exhaustive branch coverage. Eight partial source illustrations use synthetic filler. Other cases are not independent expected answers.
